name: team
summary: A team: a staged-files check before each commit, a changed-files gate on every pull request, and existing debt accepted so only new findings fail.

scope.detail: staged files locally, files changed since the base branch in a pull request

notes: Run `meerkat verify` once on the main branch, then `meerkat baseline` to accept what is already there. After that `--ratchet` runs fail only on new findings.
Change origin/main to your base branch if it is named differently.
